title: I do ... I did ... (review)
text: These days, I sometimes work from home and have online meetings.
Now I often shop online and pay on my smartphone.
In the past, I worked in an office.
Twenty years ago, I went to shops and paid in cash.
Liu Jiajia wrote about the changes in her grandmother's life. Complete the passage.
Fifty years ago, my grandmother _______ (walk) to different places. There _______ (be) no phones. She _______ (write) letters to her friends.

Now she _______ (go) to different places by e-bike or metro. She also _______ (use) a smartphone. Sometimes she _______ (write) emails. My grandmother and I often _______ (chat) on the internet. It is great!
sentences: These days, I sometimes work from home and have online meetings.
Now I often shop online and pay on my smartphone.
In the past, I worked in an office.
Twenty years ago, I went to shops and paid in cash.
